dependencies.statement:
In the regime of @lem-disk-perturbation, for every prevertex arc $I$ corresponding to a straight effective edge, the disk normal derivative $p=-\partial_rv|_{\partial\mathbb D}$ satisfies
$$
\operatorname{osc}_I p
\le C S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$
Moreover $p\ge p_D/2$ on the boundary for sufficiently small $S$.
dependencies.title: Uniform disk pressure oscillation

dependencies.statement:
Let $h>0$ be monotone on $[0,\varepsilon]$. Define the normalized physical coordinate
$$
x(s)=\frac{\int_0^s h(t)dt}{\int_0^\varepsilon h(t)dt},
\qquad \widetilde k_0(x)=h(s(x))^{-2}.
$$
Suppose $p_0\le p(s(x))\le2p_0$ and
$$
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(s(x))^2\widetilde k_0(x)dx=0.
$$
Then
$$
D:=\frac{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)-h(t)/h(s))dsdt}
{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)+h(t)/h(s))dsdt}
\le C\frac{\operatorname{osc}p}{p_0}.
$$
dependencies.title: Monotone weight double-integral comparison

dependencies.statement:
Under @def-conformal-data and @lem-edge-moments, let $p=-\partial_rv|_{\partial\mathbb D}$, $h=|F'|$, and normalize one straight edge by physical arclength $x\in[0,1]$. Then
$$
q(x)=p(\theta(x))^2h(\theta(x))^{-2},
$$
and, with $k_0=h^{-2}$,
$$
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(\theta(x))^2k_0(x)\,dx=0.
$$
dependencies.title: Conformal pressure moment identity

dependencies.statement:
Suppose the turn measure in @def-turn-measure has exactly one negative atom $-b$ at $0$, with $0<b<1/2$, and let $a$ be the turn weight at one of the two adjacent positive vertices. There is a choice of one adjacent edge on which $h=|F'|$ is monotone and, after orienting it decreasingly,
$$
\log h(\theta_-)-\log h(\theta_+)\ge c(a+b)
$$
on a central half of the edge.
dependencies.title: Monotone edge next to the unique reflex corner

target.proof:
By @lem-reflex-monotone-edge, the selected adjacent edge has monotone $h$ and a central logarithmic drop at least $c(a+v)$. The elementary rectangle comparison in that lemma gives $D_I\ge c(a+v)$. By @lem-physical-pressure-moment, the edge moments give the centered condition in the normalized physical coordinate, and @lem-monotone-weight-comparison applies with $p_0=p_D/2$ once $S$ is sufficiently small. By @lem-edge-pressure-oscillation, $p_D/2\le p\le2p_D$ and therefore
$$
D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p.
$$
Combining the two inequalities proves the result.
target.statement:
Suppose the turn measure in @def-turn-measure has exactly one negative atom $-v$ and let $a>0$ be one of the two adjacent positive atoms selected by the monotonicity sign. Under the edge moments @lem-edge-moments, there is a corresponding edge arc $I$ such that
$$
c(a+v)\le D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p,
$$
where
$$
D_I=\frac{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)-h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt}
{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)+h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt},
\qquad h=|F'|.
$$
target.title: One-reflex edge pressure comparison

critical_errors: With p_0=p_D/2, @lem-monotone-weight-comparison requires p_D/2\le p\le p_D. The proof asserts p_D/2\le p\le2p_D, while @lem-edge-pressure-oscillation actually supplies only p\ge p_D/2. Thus the comparison lemma cannot be applied.

Even if an upper bound p\le2p_D were available, the comparison lemma would yield D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p/p_0=2C\operatorname{osc}_I p/p_D. No supplied statement identifies p_D with a normalized constant or gives a lower bound allowing this to become the target D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p.
gaps: The claimed lower bound from the central logarithmic drop is delegated to an “elementary rectangle comparison” without supplying the integral estimate showing that the central-half information controls the full double-integral ratio.
The proof does not explicitly verify that the edge selected by @lem-reflex-monotone-edge is a straight effective edge to which the two pressure lemmas apply.
report.repair_hints: Supply a bound satisfying the comparison lemma exactly (with p_0 chosen consistently), and state the normalization or uniform lower bound for p_D needed to remove the factor 1/p_D. Also provide the rectangle estimate for the lower bound and identify the selected arc as a straight effective edge in the required regime.
report.summary: The proof does not establish the upper bound because the hypotheses of the monotone-weight comparison are not met. The cited pressure lemma supplies only a lower bound, and the stated bounds are also incompatible with the chosen value of p_0.
